'''Palawa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was the planet of origin of two mystic [[The Force/Legends|Force]] traditions, the [[Followers of Palawa]] and the [[Chatos Academy]].

==History==
Palawa joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

This planet was the original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Followers of Palawa]]. The planet was destroyed in a battle that had involved the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], so the Followers of Palawa relocated to [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]]<ref name="JvS" /> with the help of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Complete">{{CSWECite|III|6|Palawa}}</ref>
